interface.shortDescription: How to make any AI video
interface.longDescription: varg how to answers "how do I make this video" for an AI agent. One call to search_how_to with the person's request, in their words and in any language, returns ranked cards from 2,000+ checked AI video agent skills, how-to tutorials, FFmpeg recipes, video formats, prompts and styles. get_how_to returns the full tutorial as Markdown: the best skill, the 2-4 choices to show the person with example videos, and the steps. No account or key. To generate, connect the varg MCP (mcp.varg.ai), which puts 200+ image, video, voice and music models behind one key.
defaultPrompt: Make a UGC ad for my skincare serum.
Add TikTok style captions to this video.
Turn my song into a lyric video.
